_doc: The look of every illustration for this client. gen.py builds each prompt as: lead (character | style_only, only when 'reference' is set) + shot prompt + ink + kinds[kind] + never. PROPOSAL: criteroconsulting.se uses photographs (a tree in a field at sunset, a portrait) and thin orange line diagrams, not illustrations, so this style is drawn from the site's palette and mood and waits for Pär's approval (see NOTES.md).
character: Use the character in the attached image as the character reference: keep exactly the same person, face, hair, clothes, proportions and drawing style, instantly recognisable; never redesign them. Use only the character from the reference, not its layout or its text.
style_only: Match the drawing style of the attached image exactly: the same line, flat colour palette and shading. Take only the drawing style from it: not its character or its layout.
ink: Calm, warm editorial illustration with a quiet Scandinavian feel: soft natural light, simple flat shapes with subtle grain, generous empty space. A limited palette of warm off-white and sand (#F5F1E6, #F0EAD8), deep blue-green (#174F49), muted sage and forest greens (#86A893, #3D6E50) and one small accent of warm orange (#F49140) per image. Everyday Swedish public-sector settings: municipal offices, meeting rooms, schools, care homes, streets, landscapes with trees and open fields. Grounded and trustworthy, never glossy or futuristic.

kinds.film: A wide full-bleed illustration that fills the entire image edge to edge: no border, no frame, no rounded corners. Keep faces and key objects inside the central part of the frame with breathing room on all sides.
kinds.sheet: Laid out as a clean character model sheet on a plain light background.
kinds.scene: A full-bleed illustration that fills the entire image edge to edge: no border, no frame.
kinds.ref: A single full-body character portrait, front three-quarter view, standing, on a plain light background.

never: No text, no letters, no numbers anywhere in the image, no signs with writing, no watermark, no real people, no logos, no brand names, no robots, no glowing circuit boards or neon AI imagery.
